projects.name: Oxyra API
projects.summary: The library the other Oxyra mods share: their settings (sliders, colours, help), drawn and kept on their page in Options > Mods.
projects.description: Required by every other mod of this library.

projects.name: BetterF3
projects.summary: The F3 screen as coloured modules in two columns, sliding in and out.
projects.description: Port of cominixo's and TreyRuffy's BetterF3 (MIT): Minecraft, FPS, Graphics, Server, Coordinates, Chunks, Location, Entities, Sounds, Help, Misc / System, Targeted; each module on or off and coloured.

projects.name: Immersive Portals
projects.summary: See through Nether and End portals and cross them without a loading screen.
projects.description: After qouteall's Immersive Portals: the level behind a portal drawn through it, the crossing landing where the view showed. Single player and LAN host.

projects.name: Mod Menu
projects.summary: A Mods button on the title screen and the pause menu, and Options > Mods laid out as Mod Menu does.
projects.description: After TerraformersMC's Mod Menu: the mod list with search, sorting, libraries, details and each mod's settings.

projects.name: Mouse Tweaks
projects.summary: Drag and wheel controls in inventories.
projects.description: After YaLTeR's Mouse Tweaks: right-drag places one per slot, left-drag gathers, Shift-drag moves every slot, the wheel moves one item.

projects.name: Particle Core
projects.summary: Draws only the particles you can see, for more frames.
projects.description: Skips particles out of view, past a distance or past a per-frame limit, each with its setting.

projects.name: Physics
projects.summary: Broken blocks, explosions and dead mobs fall apart; doors and trapdoors swing.
projects.description: Inspired by haubna's Physics Mod (its behaviour only): broken blocks crumble in tumbling cubes, explosions throw debris, mobs fall as jointed ragdolls you can push and hit, doors and trapdoors swing on a damped spring.

projects.name: Lyrics
projects.summary: The lyrics of the song playing on your PC, word by word in the sky and around you.
projects.description: Port of Henner4746's Lyrics in the Sky (MIT): Spotify, a browser or any player Windows shows; synced lyrics from lrclib.net (it is sent the song's title, artist and length). Lines in the sky behind the hills, sung words floating around you, or on screen. Effects as words come and go, colours (a wheel, palettes, rainbow, gradient), a glow drawn with the game's bloom, fonts (a resource pack's TTF too), a live preview on its settings page, a demo to try it in the world and a song card. With Oxyra FX (optional): light where words come and go and a ball that bounces onto each word. Needs Oxyra with hooks 371.

projects.name: Oxyra FX
projects.summary: An effects library: light pillars, rune blooms, fairy rings, energy vortices, prismatic ribbons, wandering souls and more, with light that adds up.
projects.description: Port of ActuallyCryx's Vibe Client effects (CC0), one to one: its painted sprites, its 17 effects and its two passes (blended, and additive light hidden by what stands in front). Each effect on or off with its colour; density, size, speed for all; a test setting. Other mods (Lyrics) use it for their own effects. Needs Oxyra with hooks 371.

projects.name: Smooth Input
projects.summary: Keeps the frame rate with high polling rate mice (1000 to 8000 Hz).
projects.description: After decce6's Ixeris (its idea only): the mouse's raw reports are read in batches and applied once a frame instead of one window message each. Windows only. Needs Oxyra with hooks 368.

projects.name: ClientSort
projects.summary: Sorts inventories with the middle mouse button; fills stacks, restocks and transfers.
projects.description: Port of TerminalMC's ClientSort (Apache-2.0, notice included): Shift sorts by quantity, Control by name, Alt by item ID; orders and keys in its settings. Ordinary clicks only, so it works on any server.

projects.name: ShulkerBoxTooltip
projects.summary: A container's contents in its tooltip.
projects.description: Port of MisterPeModder's ShulkerBoxTooltip (MIT): Shift for the compact preview, Alt as well for the full one, Control to lock it; themes, positions and colours.
